genre: round-based tactical first-person shooter in the Counter-Strike style; original map, art and names
engine: three.js 0.187.0 vendored, plain ES modules, no build step, no network at runtime
premise: Two crews fight over a brick kiln works. PACKERS carry a cinder charge to site A or B; WARDENS hold the sites and defuse. First to five rounds.

controls.move: W A S D, with acceleration and friction
controls.fire: left mouse (automatic on rifle and SMG)
controls.buy: B in the buy phase, then 1-6 or a click
controls.objective: hold E: plant as a Packer, defuse as a Warden
controls.grenade: G, one PITCH frag a round

systems.loop: main.js runs a fixed 60 Hz step with an accumulator and renders once per frame; rendering only reads state
systems.movement: player.js: acceleration, friction, crouch with stand-up check, jump, gravity, axis-separated collision, crate tops landable
systems.gunplay: combat.js: four weapons, spread growing with speed and shrinking crouched, recoil that recovers, headshot multiplier, armour soaks half a hit
systems.hits: hitscan rays against head, body and leg boxes; a wall always wins; bot damage is scaled so a bot cannot one-shot through a door
systems.navigation: nav.js: authored door, lane and hold nodes plus a 3 m walkable lattice, edges only where a body fits, A* with a binary heap and reused scratch
systems.bots: bots.js: advance, hold, engage, investigate, reload, plant, defuse; hearing with a noise memory and a give-up deadline, burst fire with an accuracy ramp, cover while reloading, a sideways detour when a re-path repeats
systems.objective: match.js: 3.2 s plant on a site radius, 40 s fuse, one 10 s defuse that resets on release or interruption, wins by detonation, defuse, elimination or time
systems.economy: start $800; kill $300, plant $300, win $3250, loss $1400 rising to $3400; six items, buying closed after the buy phase
systems.rounds: 12 s buy, 100 s live, 6 s result, first to five, then restart
systems.hud: hud.js: health, armour, money, weapon, ammo, round, clock, score, phase, objective, bomb fuse, kill feed, hit marker, buy menu, banners
systems.audio: audio.js: synthesised shots, reload, hit, headshot, explosion, plant, defuse, win and lose cues
systems.look: render/: canvas textures, gradient sky, dusk sun with shadows, lamps, lane stripes, site decals, signs, first-person rifle, pooled tracers, impacts, blood, explosions

map.size: 48 x 40 m, two lanes around a solid kiln block, a north corridor for rotates
map.site_a: KILN FLOOR: roofed brick building, south and east doors, three crate stacks
map.site_b: CISTERN YARD: open steel pen, south and west mouths, a cistern tank and a low wall
map.palette: warm brick against cool steel, amber site decals and lane stripes, dusk sky that never renders black

file_map.game/index.html: import map, HUD markup, link to the stylesheet
file_map.game/style.css: the whole look plan in one stylesheet
file_map.game/src/map.js: boxes, lamps, signs, nav nodes, spawns, sites
file_map.game/src/combat.js: weapon table, spread, hit scan, damage, blast
file_map.game/src/sim.js: the fixed step that ties the systems together and emits events
file_map.tools/capture.py: captures the screenshots from the running game
file_map.tools/imagecheck.py: decodes each screenshot and checks size and brightness

test_hooks.why: the judge never runs the game, so the tests and captures drive the same calls the loop makes
test_hooks.__debug: phase, clock, score, player, ammo, bomb, bots, stats, last result
test_hooks.__advance __tp __fire __buy __plant __de: step time, move the player, shoot, buy, hold the objective key, arm a fixture charge
test_hooks.__view __hudText: a 3x3 ray probe of the frame, and the HUD's rendered strings
